load the plants or plant products, must be in force for the bulk vessel, and not suspended,

A person prescribed by section 8-1 must, at the time prescribed by section 8-3, give the

products.

The exporter of the plants or plant products must hold an export permit for the plants or
plant products and the export permit must be in force, and not suspended, at the time the
plants or plant products are exported.

Products) Order 2011, as in force immediately before the commencement time.
